title: A column of a table variable cannot be referenced as Variable[Column]
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR Expensive = FILTER ( Product, Product[Price] >= 50 ) RETURN SUMX ( Expensive, Expensive[Price] ) )

expected.error: Expensive is a variable, not a table of the model: Expensive[Price] cannot be resolved

source.quote: You can't reference columns in table variables by using TableName[ColumnName] syntax.
source.supports: the variable name is not a table name for column references

source.quote: It would seem intuitive to refer to the Unit Price column in BestProducts as BestProducts[Unit Price] . Unfortunately, this syntax is not available.

derivation: Expensive[Price] uses the variable name as a table prefix, which both sources say is not possible, so the query fails.
